important_notice: Prepared dishes do not have one exact universal nutrient value. Recipe, ingredient variety, oil absorption, cooking loss and restaurant portioning change values. Entries in this file are standardized estimates for a representative recipe and should not be treated as laboratory analyses or medical-grade measurements.

methodology.energy_formula: Atwater general factors: 4 kcal/g protein + 4 kcal/g carbohydrate + 9 kcal/g fat; rounded to nearest kcal.
methodology.numeric_precision: Macronutrients rounded to 0.1 g; energy rounded to 1 kcal. Precision does not imply laboratory exactness.
methodology.reference_framework: Indian Food Composition Tables 2017 (ICMR-NIN) for ingredient-level context; dish values are standardized recipe estimates.
methodology.recommended_use: Food search, meal-planning prototypes and general nutrition education.
methodology.not_recommended_for: Clinical dietetics, allergy management, legal nutrition labels or dosing decisions without recipe-level laboratory validation.

sources.title: Indian Food Composition Tables 2017
sources.scope: Reference composition data for Indian foods/ingredients
